title: Implement FT-001 protected-route and context-builder authz seams
verify: Protected route dependency fails closed for missing, invalid, expired, disabled, or membership-disabled sessions.
Context builders use ActorContext and the canonical PlantPermissionContext interface envelope before returning scoped context.

PlantPermissionContext compatibility checks cover plant_id, plant_status, can_read, can_comment, can_operate, can_create_domain_tasks, can_manage_access, can_approve_actions, source, and optional grant_id.
Denied Plant context, including source=denied, missing grant, revoked grant, and archived-normal-operation denial, is filtered before Bus/model context is prepared.
Bus/context-builder output excludes session IDs, tokens, token hashes, password hashes, auth headers, cookies, UI Feed, raw chat, and unapproved proposal content.
Generic protected-route/context-builder Plant denial uses AUTH_PLANT_FORBIDDEN without leaking Plant existence; the concrete FT-002 HTTP catalog remains deferred.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and explicit owner closure; /mb-sync runs at the wave boundary.
evidence_required: PlantPermissionContext canonical shape and FT-002 compatibility evidence
denial filtering evidence for source=denied, missing grant, revoked grant, and archived-normal-operation paths
AUTH_PLANT_FORBIDDEN no-existence-leak evidence for generic FT-001 protected seams
constraints: Context builders must resolve ActorContext and PlantPermissionContext before returning events or scoped data.
Use the canonical ActorContext PlantPermissionContext envelope and concrete resolver output fields.
Filter denied Plant contexts before Bus/model context is prepared, including source=denied, missing grant, revoked grant, and archived-normal-operation denial.
Generic protected seams use AUTH_PLANT_FORBIDDEN for Plant denial; do not invent the deferred FT-002 HTTP error catalog.
Agent Chat Bus context must include authorization_scope but not session/auth material.
Do not implement agent output publication, Bus event payload taxonomy, MessageEnvelope validation, or UI Feed projection.

Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors per Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, and Evidence Redaction specs; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: UI Feed, raw chat, raw reasoning, admin notices, and unapproved Companion proposals never become agent working context.
Agent-originated domain output must pass project-owned runtime decision, MessageEnvelope, and Agent Chat Bus boundaries.
Secrets/auth material must not enter agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check context-builder tests prove canonical PlantPermissionContext shape compatibility with FT-002 fields and denial filtering before scoped context leaves the boundary.
Check generic Plant denial uses AUTH_PLANT_FORBIDDEN without leaking Plant existence or inventing FT-002 HTTP errors.
Check context-builder output excludes auth material, UI Feed, raw chat, admin notices, and unapproved proposal content per the Bus, MessageEnvelope, and UI Feed contracts.
purpose: Provide the reusable protected-route and context-builder seams that later product features must call before Farm/Plant data access.
success_outcome: Later routes and context builders can require ActorContext and produce safe authorization-scoped context without leaking auth material.

forbidden_scope: Agent Chat Bus event payload implementation
raw auth material in context output
stop_conditions: Context-builder authorization cannot be proven before data exposure.
PlantPermissionContext shape or denial semantics conflict with FT-001 or FT-002 specs.
Auth material exclusion cannot be tested.
Implementation requires owning FT-007/FT-008 agent publication behavior.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
